parsed.rationale: After the last release, the analytics dashboard load time increased from under 5 seconds to 30–45 seconds. This is a performance regression affecting multiple users, likely requiring engineering review.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for reporting this performance regression. Based on what you shared, after the most recent release the analytics dashboard now takes ~30–45 seconds to load (previously <5 seconds), and this is impacting 25 operations users’ daily planning, though the page does eventually load. 

We’ve escalated this to our engineering team for investigation as a release-related performance issue. In the meantime, could you share the following details so we can narrow down where the time is being spent?

1) The specific release version and/or release date/time when you first noticed the change (and whether it’s the same for all users).
2) “Load” definition: does it mean the page is fully interactive/rendered, or first display?
3) Affected environment: are you seeing it across all browsers/regions, or only certain ones?
4) Any browser console errors and/or server-side logs you can capture during a slow load (timestamps when it happens are especially helpful).
5) Whether other pages are also slower, or only the analytics dashboard.

If you can, please also attach a HAR file or performance trace from one of the slow sessions (around when it takes 30–45 seconds). Once we have those details, we can provide the engineering team with the most actionable data to compare before/after release behavior.
promised_actions: We will forward/escalate the report to the engineering team for investigation.
We will review the additional diagnostics you provide to narrow down the cause and scope.
safety_notes: Avoid promising a specific fix time or confirming root cause in the reply.
Request minimal, actionable clarifications (release version/date, load definition, environment, logs/HAR, scope).
